pro.badgeHint: Pro page: files are stored in the browser with OPFS.
pro.title: Bulkut Pro — local video editing with OPFS, no size limit
pro.description: Bulkut Pro — cut silences, trim clips and reverse videos locally with OPFS storage and ffmpeg.wasm.
pro.note: OPFS mode: videos are streamed from browser storage and mounted read-only in FFmpeg, so the import size limit does not apply. They stay on this device.
pro.storageNote: Stored locally in your browser with OPFS — no import size limit.

why.title: A video editor that never uploads your files
why.body: Bulkut is a free video editor that runs entirely in your browser: FFmpeg is compiled to WebAssembly and executed on your own machine, so your footage is never sent to a server.
why.free: 100% free — no ads, no account, no watermark and no export limit.
why.local: No upload, no cloud and no tracking: your videos stay on your device.
why.offline: Works offline once the engine is cached, and as a single portable executable on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android.

autocut.title: Autocut: silence removal
autocut.body: FFmpeg detects silences and removes them in a single pass, with a threshold, before/after margins and a minimum clip duration — globally or per video.

cut.title: Fastcut, reverse and splitter
cut.body: Trim an exact excerpt with timecodes, reverse a clip with its audio, or export several segments of the same video at once.

assemble.title: Collage and intro/outro
assemble.body: Join clips in any order, add a shared intro and outro, and watch the final duration update as you edit the list.

timeline.title: Editor timelines
timeline.body: Export the cut as a Premiere Pro, Vegas Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or Shotcut project instead of re-encoding a video.

free.a: Yes. Every tool is free and unlimited: no ads, no subscription, no account and no watermark. There is no server to run, so there is nothing to pay for.

upload.q: Are my videos uploaded to a server?
upload.a: No. FFmpeg is compiled to WebAssembly and runs in your browser, so files are read and written locally. The desktop build runs FFmpeg natively on your machine. There is no upload and no tracking.

offline.a: Yes. The web app works offline once the engine is cached by your browser, and the desktop builds are single executables that always run offline.

limit.q: Is there a file size limit?
limit.a: The classic page is limited by your browser's memory. The Pro page stores files with OPFS to lift the import size limit, and the desktop build reads videos straight from disk with no size limit.

formats.a: MP4 renders, plus editor timelines for Premiere Pro and Vegas Pro (XML), DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro (FCPXML), and Shotcut (MLT).

pro.title: Long videos, still 100% local
pro.body: Bulkut Pro keeps imports in OPFS, the browser's private storage, and streams them from there into FFmpeg. The import size limit of a normal page no longer applies, and nothing is uploaded.

points.tools: The same six tools as the standard page.
points.storage: Stored in your browser and deletable at any time.
points.desktop: Need more? The desktop build reads straight from disk with no size limit.

download.title: The same editor, natively
download.body: The desktop and Android builds embed FFmpeg: the app extracts it next to the executable on first launch, then works without a network connection. Files are read from disk and rendered on your machine — no upload, no account, no ads.

points.threads: Multithreaded native FFmpeg for faster renders.
points.offline: One portable executable, no installer, works offline.
points.limit: No import size limit: videos are read straight from disk.
points.free: 100% free, no ads, no account and no watermark.
